title: Security Blocker
description: Schema for an individual security blocker entry in Security_Blockers.md. Each blocker represents a finding that prevents Gate 5 approval.

severity.description: Only CRITICAL and HIGH findings are blockers.

gate_status_code.description: The Gate 5 status code this blocker triggers.

location.description: Exact file path and line number (e.g., app/api/users/route.ts:42).

description.description: Precise description of the vulnerability with evidence and impact.

vulnerable_code_snippet.description: The exact vulnerable code snippet (quoted from source).

decision_rule.description: Decision rule that triggered this blocker.

remediation_steps.description: Ordered remediation steps for the Dev agent.

responsible_agent.description: Which Dev agent is responsible for fixing this blocker.

escalate_to_tech_lead.description: True if Tech Lead must also be notified (always true for CRITICAL findings).

secret_rotation_required.description: True if a secret was exposed and must be rotated in addition to code fix.

systemic_pattern.description: True if this vulnerability class was found in 3+ locations (DR015).
